**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Raise the nested v4 verification timeout**

In the newly added CI verification chain, `verify-correction-v5.mjs` executes this archived v5 script, but this 60-second child deadline is no larger than the valid runtime of the recursively copying and recomputing v4 verifier. On a clean checkout of this commit, `node experiments/material-facts-v7/verify-correction-v5.mjs` failed here with `spawnSync ... ETIMEDOUT`, after the standalone v4 verification had passed, so the required CI/check path can fail on an unmodified tree. Increase or remove this nested deadline, or avoid recursively repeating the historical recomputations.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L7-L7](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/bd1cf39e66459f793b7702fa81c328cbd15034e2/AGENTS.md#L7-L7)
